CROP: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame. overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more bare shoulder and collarbone inside the crop; the crop stays exactly where CROP sets it and never moves down to show more; cover the chest
